full_judgment: 3. The case of the Plaintiff-opposite parties, in short, is that the suit land originally belonged to Zaminder Kumar Auran Chandra Singh Bahadur. During District Survey 12.75 decimals of land was recorded in khatian No. 3 in the name of Roy Raj Kumar Dutta Bahadur in thirteen annas share in `ka' group, Naba Chandra Sur in three annas share. On the basis of oral settlement, District Khatian No.11 was recorded in the name of Sree Boikuntha Kumar Dey; that the predecessor of the plaintiff Sree Boikuntha Kumar Dey took settlement of the land of an area of 83 decimals in plot No. 44, khatian No. 3 of District Survey by registered Kabuliyat No. 3121 dated 26 Kartick, 1323 BS. Since the Kabuliyat was executed after field survey and before publication of khatian, the District khatian was prepared in the name of Naba Chandra Sur. But in fact, Raiyat Boikuntha was in khas possession of the said land by paying regular rent to the landlord. Boikuntha sold out an area of 13 decimals of land out of 152½ decimals of land to Prasanna on 17-4-1930 from the land of District Khatian No. 11 and possessed the rest land by excavating pond and constructing house thereon and he died leaving behind two sons, Din Bandhu Majumder and Jagabandhu Majumder. Din Bandhu died leaving behind Haripada Majumder; that Jagabandhu and Haripada settled out 42 decimals of land out of 139½ decimals from plot No. 44 to Sree Ashutosh Narayan Chowdhury. Jagabandhu died leaving behind the plaintiff Nos.1-4 and another son Pran Gopal who died unmarried. In this way, the plaintiffs are in possession of 971½ decimals of land from plot No. 44. The defendant No. 1, the petitioner is in possession of 25½ decimals of land from the District Khatian No. 3 group 'kha' which is covered by the boundary in the northern and western side and the land in the southern side is the land of other mouza and that north and east side covered by barbed wire. The suit MRR khatian was wrongly recorded in the names of the defendants and hence, filed this suit.
